html:
MIT signal processing legend Oppenheim made a series of free signal processing videos that are worth a look. The picture quality and the professor’s mustache are both very moving. That said, the old-school slides in them are more intuitive than PowerPoint.

If you want to study more intensively, you can pay for courses on MOOC sites like edX and Coursera. There are assignments that someone actually grades, and you get a certificate at the end. More and more people recognize these certificates now, and you can put them on your CV.
